newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The UAE is to introduce a new law that will give the Central Bank more powers to enforce stricter regulation of the growing financial sector, bankers and economists say.
- Arab personal computer market surged by 25 percent in 1996, study says.
- Abu Dhabi Airport Duty Free profits to reach 300 million dirhams this year, official says.
- Chrysler says sales in the Middle East up by 14 percent so far this year.
- The number of bank branches opened by UAE banks has risen 20 percent over the past five years.
- Up to 450 exhibitors from 32 countries to take part in the Gitex computer and software exhibition in Dubai in October.
- The UAE's trade with Britain rose 20.5 percent in the first half of this year over the same period in 1996, British embassy report says.
